mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, the temperature is 72 degrees with a feels-like temperature of 77 under clear skies at the Verona Area High School. The moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

The City of Verona Common Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates. These utilities are self-supporting, and the increase will help cover rising maintenance costs and infrastructure improvements to prevent future system failures like flooding or sewer backups.
There is a lot going on in town today, including the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and Hop Haus Trivia this evening.
Regarding the weekly police report, on August 15, officers arrested a 29-year-old man for his second O W I offence after a citizen reported him as a reckless driver.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. The shop is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
